principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix automotive precision with SaaS utility.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel 'tuned' and responsive.
Content is King: Data and services are the heroes.
Contrast: High contrast is non-negotiable. Red on Black.

headings.usage: All page titles, section headers, and card titles.

rules: Never use gradients for the background. Stick to pure black #000000.
Use the primary red (#e80200) sparingly for CTAs, active states, and critical alerts.
Ensure text contrast is at least 4.5:1. Use #ffffff for main text and #ababab for secondary.

visual_enhancers.shadows: None or very subtle. Prefer flat, high-contrast layers.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). Avoid rounded-xl or pill shapes to maintain the 'mechanical' feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or carbon fiber patterns are acceptable in small doses, but keep it clean.

admin_dashboard.sidebar: Fixed width (250px), dark gray background (#0a0a0a), red active indicators.
admin_dashboard.grid: Bento Grid for Dashboard Home (Stats, Recent Bookings, Quick Actions).
admin_dashboard.spacing: Dense but legible. p-6 for containers.

booking_page.structure: Step-by-step Wizard or Single Page Scroll with Sticky Summary.

Button.base: font-oswald uppercase tracking-wide font-bold transition-all duration-200

variants.outline: border border-[#e80200] text-[#e80200] hover:bg-[#e80200] hover:text-white rounded-sm

Card.base: bg-[#111111] border border-[#262626] p-6 rounded-sm hover:border-[#e80200] transition-colors duration-300
Card.usage: Service items, dashboard widgets, booking summaries.

Input.base: bg-[#0a0a0a] border border-[#262626] text-white placeholder-[#525252] focus:border-[#e80200] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#e80200] rounded-sm h-12

Table.header: bg-[#111111] text-[#ababab] font-oswald uppercase text-sm tracking-wider p-4

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Create a 'tailwind.config.js' file in '/app/frontend/' if it doesn't exist. Configure it to scan './src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}' and add the custom colors (primary: #e80200, etc.) to the theme extension.
Install 'lucide-react' for icons if not present.
Create a new layout for the Admin Dashboard that is distinct from the public site but shares the same typography and color DNA.
For the Booking Page, ensure it integrates with the existing 'App.js' routes. You might need to replace or update the existing '/book-appointment' route.
Use 'fetch' or 'axios' to communicate with the FastAPI backend (which you will also build/update).
Ensure all new components use the 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
The Admin Dashboard must be protected (simple login).
Implement the 'Service Management' logic to allow dynamic addition of services which then reflect on the Booking Page.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for the background. Stick to pure black #000000.
Use the primary red (#e80200) sparingly for CTAs, active states, and critical alerts.
Ensure text contrast is at least 4.5:1. Use #ffffff for main text and #ababab for secondary.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
